cases.case_label: FKTN retrotransposon insertion on one allele (with novel noncoding FKTN variants)
cases.mechanism_detail: Targeted resequencing in a patient carrying a heterozygous FKTN retrotransposon insertion found two novel noncoding FKTN variants as candidate second hits; the insertion's mechanism is not described.
cases.quote: Two novel noncoding variants of FKTN were identified in one patient who had a retrotransposon insertion mutation of FKTN in only one allele.
